nodes.title: Fit portrait to the 832 x 1120 work canvas
Apply the HOI4 FLUX.2 Klein 9B LoRA
Conservative restoration instructions
widgets_values: Restore this historical head-and-shoulders portrait conservatively. Repair scratches, fading, compression, and lost fine detail. Preserve the person's exact identity, facial geometry, expression, hairstyle, clothing, pose, camera angle, and crop. Keep period-authentic texture. Colorize monochrome or sepia material only when the colors can remain plausible. Do not stylize.

nodes.title: Conservative restoration negative
widgets_values: changed identity, changed face, altered expression, different hairstyle, different clothing, modern accessories, beauty retouching, plastic skin, painterly style, fantasy details, text, watermark

nodes.title: Toggle FLUX restoration (on: ESRGAN then FLUX; off: ESRGAN only)
Person-only LoRA instructions
widgets_values: hoi4_portrait, a middle-aged man with fair skin, dark wavy hair parted at the center, a neat moustache, round wire-frame glasses, a reserved closed-mouth expression and direct gaze, wearing a buttoned high-collared uniform with two chest pockets, shoulder straps, collar stars, and a small wing-shaped sleeve insignia, shown from the chest up at a slight angle.

nodes.title: Person-only LoRA negative
widgets_values: different person, changed facial geometry, altered expression, different hairstyle, different clothing, deformed face, asymmetrical eyes, extra limbs, invented insignia, invented medals, invented hat, invented glasses, invented facial hair, invented accessories

nodes.title: Fit background to final master canvas
Composite only after the styled portrait exists

extra.description: Source portrait workflow: RealESRGAN first, optional FLUX.2 Klein 9B restoration second, HOI4 LoRA styling, then optional background replacement.
